lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly `uv lock --upgrade`, for the indirect dependencies (ctranslate2, onnxruntime, tokenizers, ...) that no rule below covers. The 14-day minimum age is enforced by uv itself here (exclude-newer in pyproject.toml): this PR has no release dates, so Renovate's own check would stay pending forever.

customManagers.description: ruff pinned in CI (RUFF_VERSION) follows the ruff-pre-commit rev in .pre-commit-config.yaml
Runner versions in workflow matrices (os: [ubuntu-24.04, ...]); the github-actions manager only reads plain runs-on values

packageRules.description: CI tooling and dev-only dependencies: group and automerge when CI passes

Runner OS versions (runs-on and matrix os) get their own PR, so a new OS that breaks a job doesn't hold back action updates. The datasource has no release dates, so the minimum release age can't apply.
installer-clean-windows runs a servercore:ltsc2022 container, which needs a Windows Server 2022 host
Python deps: keep the >= ranges in pyproject.toml and move the versions pinned in uv.lock
Dev extras (pytest, ruff, lupa, pre-commit, piper-tts) are low risk
Runtime deps reach users with the next release: never automerge, one PR per package
